water.name: Land
water.rule: Philippine archipelago land (GADM 4.1) or neighboring countries (Natural Earth).

water.name: Ocean
water.rule: Sea deeper than 200 m and not next to land.

water.name: Coast
water.rule: Sea next to a land hex, or shallower than 200 m (ETOPO1).

water.name: Lake
water.rule: Inland lakes (Laguna de Bay, Lake Lanao, Taal Lake).

relief.name: Flat
relief.rule: Lowland plains and coastal flats (std < 65 m, mean < 350 m).

relief.name: Hills
relief.rule: Rolling uplands (std ≥ 65 m or mean ≥ 350 m).

relief.name: Mountains
relief.rule: Mountain ranges (std ≥ 200 m or mean ≥ 1,000 m).

relief.name: Peaks
relief.rule: High peaks (mean ≥ 1,700 m: Cordillera, Mt. Apo, Mt. Kitanglad).

cover.name: Deciduous forest
cover.rule: Forest (41+42+43) is the largest group and deciduous (41) the largest forest type.

cover.name: Conifer forest
cover.rule: Forest is the largest group and evergreen (42) the largest forest type.

cover.name: Mixed forest
cover.rule: Forest is the largest group and mixed (43) the largest forest type.

cover.name: Scrub & desert
cover.rule: Shrub/scrub (52) is the largest group: deserts, chaparral, sagebrush.

cover.name: Grassland
cover.rule: Grassland/herbaceous (71) plus developed open space (21: lawns, parks) is the largest group.

cover.name: Cropland
cover.rule: Cultivated crops (82) is the largest group.

cover.name: Wetland
cover.rule: Woody (90) plus emergent herbaceous (95) wetlands is the largest group.

cover.name: Urban
cover.rule: Developed low/medium/high intensity (22+23+24) is ≥ 30% of the hex's land, whatever else is there.

cover.name: Barren
cover.rule: Barren land (31: rock, sand, playa) is the largest group.

cover.name: Ice & snow
cover.rule: Perennial ice/snow (12) is the largest group.

notes.water: Philippines archipelago hexes (9 km radius) from GADM 4.1 boundaries and NOAA ETOPO1 bathymetry.
notes.relief: From NOAA ETOPO1 (~3.7 km grid) tuned for Philippine mountain ranges.
notes.cover: Modelled per hex from PSA Land Classification (2021) provincial forest shares, 2024 Census urbanization, and ETOPO1 relief.
